title: Game & Watch Gallery 4
sources: own knowledge of the game (facts written for this def)
notes: Genre: Collection. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text:
Each Game & Watch has a Classic (original LCD) and a Modern (Mario characters) version.
Score points to earn stars; stars unlock more games.
widgets.label: How to play

widgets.text:
D-pad moves, A/B act as the original buttons
Select returns to the gallery
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: Classic LCD titles such as Fire, Octopus, Chef, Mario's Cement Factory, Donkey Kong Jr. and Boxing, with more in the museum
widgets.label: Main games

widgets.text: Every game awards up to 5 stars per mode by score.
widgets.label: Stars

widgets.text:
Misses end the game: most games allow 3.
Scores of 200/500 often clear the misses.
Speed rises with score, so stay ahead of the rhythm.
widgets.label: Scoring

widgets.text:
Gallery: pick a game
Museum: unlocked extra games and records
Options/records: high scores per game
widgets.label: Menus

widgets.text: Stars earned in any game open new games and museum items.
widgets.label: Using stars

widgets.text:
Unlocked original Game & Watch units, playable in their LCD form.
Collect stars to fill it.
widgets.label: Museum

widgets.text: Earn 5 stars in both modes of every game to complete the gallery.
widgets.label: Goal
